items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Bottoms was such a nice, honest man. He was there right on the dot, he'd pay us.

ctx.x: Always cash. Never paid us by check. Paid us in cash. Mr. Bottoms was such a nice, honest man. He was there right on the dot, he'd pay us. They'd always pay us on -- they never tried to cheat us.
